subject: Issue with invoice VEN006-0027 – input tax credit
body:
Dear Prime Electronics LLP team,

We are reconciling our purchases with GSTR-2B and found that invoice VEN006-0027 dated 2 Sep 2025 is not shown in your return. Consequently Rs 597 of input tax credit is at risk.

Please report the invoice in your return and confirm once it appears. We will hold the credit note until then.

Accounts team
